tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page background; body text sits on it as `ink`. Inset 'path' cards also use it.

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: Raised surface: cards, inputs, tab bar, buttons in segmented controls. Text on it is `ink` or `muted`.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body text and headings on `paper` and `card`; strong borders on inputs and ghost buttons.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions, chips on `paper` and `card`.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: Hairlines, card borders, empty progress segments. Decorative; not for text.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Primary buttons, active tab marker, links on `paper`.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `primary` fills.

tokens.name: ember
tokens.usage: Accent: stage numbers, current step, focus ring. Large text or marks only.

tokens.name: moss
tokens.usage: Positive / done: completed steps, progress fill, 'ok' tags.

tokens.name: demo
tokens.usage: Text and border for DEMO/warning badges on `demo-bg`.

tokens.name: demo-bg
tokens.usage: Fill behind DEMO badges and warning chips; text on it is `demo`.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Error text on `paper` and `card`.

tokens.name: inspire-motivation
tokens.usage: Left accent bar of an inspiration card with theme 'motivation'. Same in both themes in source; decorative only.

tokens.name: inspire-discipline
tokens.usage: Left accent bar, theme 'discipline'. Decorative only.

tokens.name: inspire-patience
tokens.usage: Left accent bar, theme 'patience'. Decorative only.

tokens.name: inspire-care
tokens.usage: Left accent bar, theme 'care'. Decorative only.

styles.name: card-title
styles.usage: Title inside a card (h2 element, h3 look).

styles.name: inspire
styles.usage: Bangla line of the daily inspiration card.

styles.name: stage-number
styles.usage: Stage number on `ember`; 64px / 1.1 on the Today screen.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between stage rungs.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between chips and segmented buttons.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Tight gaps, field label spacing.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card margin, grid gap.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card/task padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Page side padding, card padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap above buttons and stage blocks.

tokens.name: space-9
tokens.usage: Block gap above sections.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Heading top margin.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Everything: cards, buttons, inputs, tabs are square.

tokens.name: radius-badge
tokens.usage: DEMO badge only.

tokens.name: shadow-rule
tokens.usage: Picture frame underline on reward art; flat, no blur.

tokens.name: column-max
tokens.usage: Content column width on phone and web; centre it.

tokens.name: gutter
tokens.usage: Left and right page padding.

tokens.name: tap-min
tokens.usage: Minimum height of any tappable control.

tokens.name: cta-min
tokens.usage: Primary / secondary button height.

tokens.name: tab-min
tokens.usage: Bottom tab bar height.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Focus outline width, offset 2px, colour `ember`.
